topic: V. S. Ramachandran 1995 Cardboard Mirror Box, Cortical Remapping & Phantom Limb Unclenching (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: 1995 UC San Diego vertical cardboard Mirror Box trial where upper-limb amputee Philip Martinez watches his intact right hand stretch wide open in a $10 mirror and feels his ten-year clenched phantom left fist unclench immediately.
